tasks.instruction: Przeczytaj zdania (1.1.-1.8.). Wykorzystujac wyrazy podane wielkimi literami, uzupelnij kazde zdanie z luka tak, aby precyzyjnie oddac sens zdania wyjsciowego. Wymagana jest pelna poprawnosc ortograficzna i gramatyczna wpisywanych fragmentow zdan. Uwaga: nie zmieniaj formy podanych wyrazow. W kazda luke mozesz wpisac maksymalnie piec wyrazow, wliczajac w to wyraz juz podany. Formy skrocone (np. needn't, they're) sa liczone jako dwa wyrazy.

items.original: He was late because the traffic was heavy.
She studied hard so that she would pass the exam.
The rain caused the match to be cancelled.
items.transformed: The match was cancelled _________ the rain.

items.original: Nobody could stop him from leaving.
They cancelled the trip because of the storm.
He took an umbrella because he did not want to get wet.
The noise was so loud that I could not sleep.
She missed the bus, so she was late for work.
items.transformed: She was late for work _________ missing the bus.
